title: D.Gray-man
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In an alternate 19th century, young exorcist Allen Walker joins the Black Order, which fights the Millennium Earl and his demonic Akuma using holy artifacts called Innocence. The Earl's family, the Noah, hate God and humanity, and Allen struggles against a hidden Noah personality growing inside him.
life_message: A good life keeps walking forward, saving both humans and the suffering souls trapped in monsters.

content.note: Frequent supernatural combat; Akuma made from the souls of the dead; author toned down one scene for young readers (Wikipedia; Otaku USA; Super Power tag).
Gothic horror, dark narrative and tragedy, though one reviewer calls the spookiness Halloween-like (Wikipedia; Otaku USA; Tragedy tag).
An adult mentor drinks and gambles (to verify).
Grief and identity crisis; loved ones turned into weapons.
